stop_rules.exit_behavior: Base-crosswalk violations are recorded for the record. Year-level vote-loss violations that the vintage-matched crosswalk (data/processed/ed_to_council_crosswalk_legacy.parquet, built by build_legacy_ed_crosswalk.py from the pre-2022 DCP ED boundary files) recovers to <=1% do not fail the stage: the vintage columns dem_share_*_vintage carry the corrected measures while the legacy dem_share and the as-designed v2 columns stay untouched and documented. CD-level >3% deviations are the split-ED double-counting inherent to the production crosswalk (an inflation of CD totals, never a loss of raw votes) and are documented per district rather than fatal.

2016.combined_into_handling: Votes in "COMBINED INTO" EDs are looked up under the OLD ED's own AD-ED key and are NEVER reassigned to the successor ED named in the status. If the old key still exists in the 2026 crosswalk the votes are assigned normally; otherwise they are dropped together with all other missing-key EDs.

sum_cd_legacy_assigned_vs_raw.note: Legacy assignment sends each ED's FULL votes to every council district the ED touches, so split EDs are counted once per overlapping district; the sum over districts therefore exceeds the raw candidate total by the split-ED overlap. The area-weighted benchmark allocates ED votes by the crosswalk's area shares.

council_district_vintage_note.finding: MISMATCH: PLUTO and the sales file attach CURRENT council district lines (the post-2022 redistricting plan, in force from the 2023 cycle onward), while the 2013, 2017 and 2021 council general elections were contested under the PRE-2022 district plan (the lines adopted after the 2010 census). The close-election IV instrument maps prior-cycle (2013/2017/2021) winners onto current-district sales rows, so district identities do not line up across vintages wherever an old-plan district does not map cleanly onto its 2023-plan successor.
shapefiles_needed_to_fix: City Council Districts (2013 plan) — the NYC Department of City Planning "Bytes of the Big Apple" council-district shapefile for the 2013 district plan, which covers the 2013, 2017 and 2021 council races (NYC Open Data dataset "City Council Districts (2013)").

A vintage-matched Election District base file for the same era (BOE/DCP election-district boundaries as they existed for the 2016-2021 elections; the ED file in this repo is the 2026 vintage and already fails to match 2016-2020 ED keys, as quantified in by_year).

The 2023-plan council district file (already present: data/raw/election_districts/NYC_City_Council_Districts.shp) to build a two-way correspondence (areal overlay ED(old vintage) -> council 2013 plan, then council 2013 plan -> council 2023 plan).
council_district_vintage_note.note: Rebuilding a vintage-correct instrument also needs the 2013/2017/2021 council-race results keyed to the OLD district numbering — already present under data/raw/council_elections/{2013,2017,2021}/ and keyed to old district numbers, which is the correct side of the correspondence.
